Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.
Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.
Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.
As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.
We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.
Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

Solutions Architects on Planet’s Professional Services team are experienced technologists who work with customers to deeply understand their problems and make them successful users of Planet's product offerings.

In this role, you will apply your remote sensing, geospatial, and scientific background, combined with deep knowledge of Planet’s technologies, to design and architect solutions that provide customers with the outcomes they need for long term value.

Solutions Architects are good listeners and respected thought leaders that help guide large projects and teams to success outcomes and your efforts will be directly visible in customers' ability to make global change actionable.
This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

Architect, design, pilot and operationalize solutions, transforming customer requirements into robust solution architectures that align with your customer’s business and technology strategies.
Deliver workshops, tailored demo-apps, and workflows, designing user experiences for solution prototyping and continuously improving the applications that customers experience.
Support pre-sales and customer expansions on solution ideation and design by leveraging your remote sensing, geospatial, and geoinformatics knowledge, alongside technology experience in AI, machine learning, image processing, and geo-programming.
Act as the technical lead in solution development teams within Agile environments, supported by project managers and software engineers who own the building of the solutions.
Liaise with multiple cross-functional stakeholders, including product owners, technical project managers, and satellite and image quality engineers, for architecting the best solutions possible to Planet’s customers.
Collaborate with sales, pre-sales, marketing, business development, legal, proposals, and other teams to support bidding and technical proposal writing for large civil government and commercial projects.
Help own the customer success lifecycle from scoping and discovery, to project execution and delivery leading to customer satisfaction, value delivery and expansions.
Champion Planet’s products and offerings in-person and via online assistance by providing training, presenting at conferences, writing technical tutorials, and publishing articles and videos.
Interact and engage with users in Planet’s Education and Research program to source novel customer applications and unique insights.

4+ years of relevant work experience in a technical geospatial or remote sensing role.
Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Computer Science, Remote Sensing, Geography, or a related field.
A background in remote sensing, geoscience, or geoinformatics.
Extensive programming ability with Python for geospatial applications, applying code best practices to process imagery, manipulate vector data, and build data pipelines.
Experience with solution design, requirement gathering, product user story ideation, solutions design documentation, architecting and prototyping.
Proficiency with QGIS, ArcGIS, GDAL, ENVI or other common geospatial software.
Industry-specific knowledge and experience in domains such as forestry, natural disasters, sustainability, and agriculture.
Familiarity with cloud-computing environments such as GCP, AWS, and Azure.
Experience working in Agile, cross-functional teams, with knowledge and familiarity of efficient, metrics-based planning and delivery.
Experience using AI for productivity, coding, and demo app creation (e.g., using Streamlit).

Lead Solution Architect \& Consultant (m/w/d)
Was du bei uns bewegen kannst
Pionierarbeit \& Standortscheduling: Als technische Speerspitze gestaltest du das Wachstum von inovex in der Schweiz aktiv mit. Du verbindest technologische Glaubwürdigkeit im Pre\-Sales mit nachhaltiger Projektdelivery und legst das solide Fundament, auf dem zukünftige Teams aufbauen.
Brücke zwischen Business\-Vision \& Code: Du schliesst die Lücke zwischen Business\-Bedürfnissen und Technologie. Vage Kundenideen und komplexe Anforderungen übersetzt du treffsicher in konkrete und funktionierende Softwarelösungen.
Hands\-on Prototyping \& Software Engineering: Der Schwerpunkt deiner Rolle liegt in der aktiven Umsetzung moderner Softwarelösungen und Systemarchitekturen direkt im Kundenprojekt. Mit hoher Geschwindigkeit baust du funktionale Prototypen sowie MVPs auf.
Pre\-Sales \& Strategische Beratung: Du führst und/oder begleitest Kundengespräche und übersetzt Business\-Visionen in pragmatische, machbare Softwarekonzepte. Du führst interaktive Discovery\- sowie Architektur\-Workshops durch und lieferst fundierte Aufwandsschätzungen.
Architektur\-Standards \& Agile Führung: Für unsere Projekte definierst du technische Standards sowie strukturierte Konzepte für komplexe IT\-Landschaften. Deine Projekte steuerst du nach agilen Methoden – idealerweise untermauert durch Zertifizierungen wie Professional Scrum Developer oder Scrum Master.
Wer gut zu uns passen würde
In der Rolle als Solution IT Architect \& Consultant liegt dein Schwerpunkt klar auf der strategischen Beratung, der vorausschauenden Konzeption und dem Aufsetzen moderner Architekturmuster – weniger auf der reinen operativen Umsetzung. Du begleitest Entscheidungsträger auf Augenhöhe, bewertest neue Technologien und legst das Fundament für zukunftsfähige Softwarelösungen. Dazu bringst du Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse aus den folgenden Bereichen mit:
Fullstack\-Engineering \& Architektur\-Expertise: Du blickst auf mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung komplexer Software\-Architekturen zurück. Dein Tech\-Stack umfasst moderne Frontend\- und Backend\-Technologien (z. B. TypeScript, Kotlin / Boot oder .NET / C\#) sowie Containerisierung (Docker, Kubernetes) und CI/CD\-Pipelines.
Cloud\-Native \& Modern Tooling: Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud\-Infrastrukturen (bevorzugt AWS oder Azure) ist für dich selbstverständlich. Du entscheidest, wann Serverless\- oder Hybrid\-Cloud\-Szenarien sinnvoll sind.
Data \& AI Grundlagen: Ein solides Verständnis moderner Datenplattformen und Data Engineering rundet dein Profil ab, sodass du Kunden auch bei datengetriebenen Architekturen ganzheitlich beraten kannst.
Beratungspersönlichkeit \& Unternehmergeist: Das Schliessen der Lücke zwischen Business\-Bedürfnissen und Code treibt dich an. Du denkst unternehmerisch, überzeugst Stakeholder durch fachliche Exzellenz sowie Empathie und schätzt die Abwechslung zwischen strategischem Consulting und konkretem Coding.
Sprachkompetenz \& Reisetätigkeit: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung (mind. Level C1\), gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab. ösischkenntnisse sehen wir als zusätzliche Ergänzung. Eine projektbezogene Reisebereitschaft (hauptsächlich innerhalb der Schweiz, gelegentlich nach Deutschland) ist für dich kein Problem.
Dein Team
In Bern bauen wir gemeinsam das inovex\-Team auf. Dabei geht es nicht um die Mitarbeit in einem bestehenden Team, sondern um die aktive Mitgestaltung des Markteintritts und der Positionierung von inovex in der Schweiz.

Du arbeitest in einem kleinen, hochqualifizierten Kernteam, das den Anspruch hat, inovex im Markt nachhaltig zu etablieren – in enger Abstimmung und Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kolleg:innen in Deutschland.

Dabei verbinden wir die Erfahrung, Methoden und technologische Exzellenz eines etablierten Unternehmens mit unternehmerischem Gestaltungsspielraum vor Ort. Unsere Konzepte implementieren wir bevorzugt mit Open Source Software im Rahmen agiler Projekte.

Die meisten der von uns entwickelten Lösungen integrieren wir in bestehende IT\-Systeme, weshalb wir von Beginn unserer Projekte an auf integrierte Qualitätssicherung setzen. Bei uns verläuft kein Projekt wie das andere – je nach Kunde, Team und Technologie\-Stack ist jede Lösung einzigartig.

Unser Fokus ist jedoch immer derselbe: Mit innovativen Technologien und einem hohen Anspruch an die Sicherheit, Wartbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme wollen wir nicht nur unsere Kunden glücklich machen, sondern auch uns selbst.

What the Sr. Salesforce Architect does at Worldwide
The Senior Salesforce Architect serves as the enterprise design authority and technical owner for the Salesforce platform and its tightly coupled Certinia ecosystem, responsible for evolving the commercial technology stack to support the Sales, Marketing, and Sales Operations organizations.

This role provides architectural leadership across the lead-to-cash and opportunity-to-project lifecycles, ensuring Salesforce solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned to measurable business outcomes while integrating reliably with the broader enterprise application and data landscape.
The Senior Salesforce Architect partners closely with the IT Commercial Business Partner as the primary technology advisor to the Sales Operations team and with the Certinia system team on shared objects, integration patterns, and data flows that span Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Professional Services Automation (PSA), and the enterprise data warehouse.

This role owns the multi-year Salesforce roadmap and sets enterprise development standards for Apex, Lightning Web Components, JavaScript, Platform Events, and Flows.
It embeds AI-driven capabilities, including Agentforce, Einstein, Data Cloud, and emerging generative AI, into the commercial technology stack while managing the product backlog, overseeing service desk support, and providing direct leadership to a team of administrators and developers.

Success in this role requires deep expertise in Salesforce platform architecture, strong working knowledge of Certinia, command of commercial processes, fluency in AI-driven platform capabilities, and the ability to translate complex business challenges into governed, high-impact technology solutions within a complex, global enterprise environment.

Serve as the enterprise design authority and lead technical architect for the Salesforce platform, defining the end-to-end technical architecture, governing development standards, and owning the multi-year roadmap aligned to commercial strategy
Partner closely with the Certinia system team on shared objects, data models, integration patterns, and automation to ensure a seamless end-to-end architecture across the opportunity-to-project and quote-to-cash lifecycles, maintaining expert-level understanding of both platforms' data models, security, and governor limits
Work hand-in-hand with Sales Operations and the IT Commercial Business Partner, translating commercial priorities into actionable platform solutions, and develop documented business requirements by partnering with Sales, Marketing, and Sales Operations leaders to convert business challenges into clearly defined technology solutions
Maintain a deep understanding of Sales and Marketing processes, including lead-to-opportunity management, pipeline management, forecasting, territory and quota management, and campaign execution to ensure effective architecture and system design
Lead the design and adoption of AI capabilities on the platform, including Agentforce agents, Einstein (Sales, Service, Predictive, and Generative), Prompt Builder, and Data Cloud, ensuring use cases are governed, explainable, and aligned with measurable business value
Continuously evolve the product in alignment with Salesforce seasonal releases, evaluating new features, managing release readiness including deprecation planning, sandbox strategy, and DevOps tooling, and own the Salesforce product backlog including intake, prioritization, and sprint planning across Sales, Marketing, and Sales Operations
Oversee Salesforce service desk operations, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests, defining service-level agreements (SLAs) and triage standards, and driving continuous improvement in user experience and platform stability
Govern and enforce Salesforce best practices, coding standards, and reusable design patterns, including integrations in and out of Salesforce and in alignment with Certinia
Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions for AppExchange solutions and custom development (Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Flow), with a preference for proven, configurable solutions and a clear rationale where custom builds deliver differentiated capability
Partner with enterprise architecture, integration, security, and data teams to ensure all Salesforce solutions adhere to architectural standards, data protection, master data management, and compliance requirements

Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and mentoring for direct reports, including Salesforce administrators and developers, fostering technical depth, certification growth, and career development

AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving.

The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking.

Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.
Why can this position be exciting for you?
You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.
You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.
This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.
Where we are
Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.
Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.
Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant.
Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved.
Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions.
Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible.
Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it.

Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases).
Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags).
Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT.
Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools.
Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements.
Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use.
Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues.

Proficiency in German

Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate
A Workday consulting or CoE background
A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context

Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months.
Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands.
Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait.
Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first.

s.h: What success looks like after your first year
s.t:
The tenant runs without the implementation partner.
The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does.
The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end.
Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Claude Code is changing how engineering organizations build software, and most of them need someone to show them how. That's you.
Technical Architects help customers get real work done with Claude Code, Claude Tag (Claude Code as an agent in Slack), and the enterprise admin controls that decide whether a rollout succeeds. You'll teach customers, partners and Anthropic's own field teams. Just as important, you'll train the trainers who carry that knowledge to everyone else.
We're hands-on AI engineers who would rather teach than sell. You'll work alongside customer engineering organizations, teaching them about Claude Code and shepherding rollouts with advanced admin knowledge. Most weeks you're in front of an audience with Claude Desktop or a terminal open: thousands of engineers on a public webinar one day, a customer's platform team in their own conference room the next week, office hours in between. The prep material often reaches you the day before.
The team is growing quickly this year, scope will grow as new products ship, and the people who join now will shape how it works.

Teach in every format. Take a standing rotation on Anthropic's public webinars in front of thousands of engineers at a time. Lead workshops and multi-day onsites, in person and virtual, built around a customer's own codebase and questions. Host office hours and multi-week cohorts where engineers, partners, and account teams bring live problems.
Teach the teachers. Run train-the-trainer programs for customer technologists and champions, and certify them to deliver Anthropic's material.
Empower admins. Educate enterprise admins on the technical requirements for a strong rollout by guiding them through single sign-on, permissions, connectors, spend controls, data-handling policy, and other advanced topics.
Build fast with Claude. Turn a request into a polished deck, demo repository or plugin within a day, using the tools you teach. Explore new features the day they ship. Pick up a teammate's material and deliver it as if you wrote it.
Bring field signal back to product. Tell the Claude Code, Claude Tag and Cowork teams what customers run into, specifically enough that they can fix it.
Be the technical voice in the room. Partner with account executives, customer success managers, Applied AI Architects, support engineers and partner leads.
Travel. Expect 30 to 50%, in bursts around onsites, workshops and events.

5+ years as a software engineer, solutions architect, developer advocate or similar. You still ship code and regularly teach engineering audiences.
Current engineering range. You've shipped code other people depend on. You can go deep with a senior engineer anywhere in the stack. You use Claude Code or a similar agentic tool every day and have opinions about it.
Big-stage presence. You've held large live audiences. You sound practiced with material you got that morning, and a broken demo doesn’t faze you.
Range in one conversation. You can go from banter to a rigorous design discussion, and both feel natural.
Care for people. You do right by a struggling customer, and you won't leave a confused room behind.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class.

We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before.

Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.
Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

ILLUIN Technology est le leader français de l'IA Générative souveraine et de confiance. Votre Mission
En tant qu' Architecte de Solutions IA – Europe (Avant-Vente) , vous êtes le partenaire technique stratégique de l'équipe commerciale et le pilote technique de notre expansion sur le marché Allemand .
Votre mission est de concevoir des solutions innovantes et robustes basées sur la plateforme et les modèles d'ILLUIN, en réponse aux défis métier complexes de nos grands comptes européens. About DuploCloud
DuploCloud is an Agentic Internal Developer Platform (IDP) for DevOps and platform engineering teams. With DuploCloud , teams can automate any complex DevOps use case as an AI agent and deploy it to their entire organization in a matter of hours to days, instead of the months it has traditionally taken.

Ephemeral environments, release management, deployment automation, Kubernetes upgrades, incident triage, security patching, compliance remediation, Terraform drift detection and remediation: each becomes a governed, multi-user agent that runs inside the customer's own cloud.
Our premise is the 70/30 problem: every DevOps workflow is bespoke, but roughly 70% of what it does is the same set of functions over and over (kubectl access, tailing logs, deploying a microservice, triggering pipelines, observability, compliance reports, cost dashboards, Terraform modules), while the remaining ~30% is the logic specific to that organization.

DuploCloud delivers the common core as a shared platform and lets teams build only their custom delta as Agents on top.

The product has two components: the Agent Platform, powered by ARMOR (Agent Runtime for Multiplayer Operations), which provides shared multiplayer AI sessions, workspaces, SSO and RBAC, secrets management, audit trails, human-in-the-loop approvals, token cost controls and a Model Router for per-workflow LLM choice across Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and open-source models; and the Coding Assistant, a Claude Code plugin paired with our DevKit that lets a platform engineer describe a use case in plain English, build and test the resulting Agent against a local copy of the platform on their laptop, and publish it to their organization.

Agents ship with rich UX (forms, wizards, dashboards, status views) and are invocable from the Web UI, API, CLI, MCP, Terraform provider, and Slack/Teams. Routine, high-frequency actions run token-less as pre-coded scripts, reserving the LLM for judgment.
The platform runs fully self-hosted in the customer's cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP, onprem) or DuploCloud -managed, supports SOC 2, HIPAA and PCI compliance requirements, and is used by engineering organizations from high-growth startups to the enterprise. Headquartered in San Jose, DuploCloud is a venture backed company, Series-B funded by WestBridge Capital and StepStone Group.

We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com .

We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures & Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.
As a Product Solution Architect , you translate complex, multi-team requirements into scalable, platform-ready concepts, from requirements gathering and product design through to technical architecture, without hands-on coding. You work with client-facing teams to solve client needs while keeping products coherent across tech verticals.

You champion clean concepts, drive down technical debt, and advise engineering teams by analyzing codebases, evaluating standards, and guiding features to high-quality delivery.

Architecture & System Blueprints: Define high-level platform concepts, system topologies, and technical blueprints that resolve cross-domain dependencies while systematically reducing tech debt.
Requirements & Product Design: Partner with stakeholders to translate vague business needs into well-structured, platform-ready functional designs and technical specifications.
Technical Advisory & Quality Governance: Analyze existing codebases and implementation standards to advise engineering teams, enforce best practices, and resolve technical blockers.
Project & Delivery Alignment: Steer feature initiatives from concept to production, ensuring cross-team synchronization and timely delivery against platform milestones.
We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.

7+ years in software engineering or technical architecture, including 3+ years working as a solution, platform, or enterprise architect.
Proven experience designing platform-level architectures and system blueprints for products spanning multiple teams and domains.
Strong grounding in software design patterns, distributed systems, API design, and integration architecture.
Demonstrated ability to read and evaluate existing codebases to assess technical debt, risk, and implementation quality.
Strong analytical and communication skills, able to translate ambiguous business requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
Experience steering cross-functional delivery and aligning engineering, product, and business stakeholders without formal line-management authority.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience in travel, mobility, or e-commerce distribution platforms.
Familiarity with domain-driven design and large-scale platform migrations or modernization initiatives.
Prior experience in a technical advisory, architecture guild, or platform governance function.

You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry.
You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company.
We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.
You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.
You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!
We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company.

At Stitch, we’re building something extraordinary. As a fast-growing team of passionate marketing technologists, architects, and strategists, we bring together our diverse backgrounds and experiences to work towards one common goal: make marketers’ lives easier with Braze.
Customer engagement is becoming increasingly complex, but with the right technology, processes, and strategies in place, marketers can achieve great things. We're motivated to be drivers of what the future of martech looks like by building solutions that work.
We’re all in on Braze as the leading customer engagement platform and the cornerstone of the modern martech stack. As an Orbit-level certified Braze partner (the highest level of partnership), we work alongside marketers from some of the world’s most beloved brands to stitch together innovative solutions, better processes, and smarter strategies that make marketing magic happen in Braze.

As a Solution Architect at Stitch, you'll be responsible for gathering and analyzing technical requirements to ensure seamless integration of Braze and partner technologies within our clients’ marketing technology stacks. You'll develop detailed functional design specifications, outlining workflows and user journeys that align with business goals.

You'll also design and implement scalable, end-to-end solutions that support personalized customer experiences, managing complex data structures, user attributes, and event tracking.

Additionally, you'll leverage Braze’s segmentation tools to create dynamic audience segments, while crafting multi-channel campaign flows using Braze’s Canvas tool to drive customer engagement through automated messaging and real-time interactions.

Collaborate with other Stitchers on the Delivery team, including Business Strategists, Marketing Strategist, and Technical Producers (email developers) to gather and analyze technical requirements, ensuring Braze and partner technologies are optimally configured within the customer’s existing martech stack
Provide detailed documentation, define integration points, and ensure seamless data flow across platforms.
Develop comprehensive functional design specifications that outline how Braze’s features will support the customer's business goals. This includes defining workflows, user journeys, and business rules to deliver an efficient and scalable solution
Design and implement end-to-end solutions that bridge the gap between business objectives and technical execution. You'll ensure the architecture is robust, scalable, and tailored to meet specific customer needs while integrating seamlessly with the broader technology ecosystem
Build and manage complex data structures, including user attributes and events, to support personalized customer experiences. You'll define how customer interactions and behaviors are tracked and leveraged to enhance engagement strategies
Utilize Braze’s segmentation tools to design dynamic and static audience segments based on user behaviors, preferences, and lifecycle stages. You'll ensure that segments are leveraged effectively for targeted messaging and personalized campaign experiences
Design and implement sophisticated campaign flows using Braze’s Canvas tool, incorporating multi-step, multi-channel journeys that drive customer engagement. You’ll develop logic to automate actions, such as messaging triggers and conditions, based on real-time customer interactions and behaviors
Bring new ideas, recommendations, and solution write-ups to other Solution Architects directly, within projects, or during office hours
Effectively manage your time to achieve quarterly billable hour targets
Stay informed about the latest advancements in Braze and its technology integration partners, as well as other relevant technologies in the marketing technology space by earning and maintaining a minimum of 3 Braze certifications, including the Braze Digital Strategist certification
Occasionally travel, up to 20%, to client sites to actively participate in strategic discussions with a high level of engagement

As Managed OpenShift penetrates further into customer cloud strategies, you will be responsible for articulating how organizations can use these services to their advantage in their search for operational efficiency, faster time to value, and reduced operational burden.

Along with being able to articulate the value of Cloud Services, you will bring technical expertise that enables you to help remove organizational, competitive, and technical blockers to adoption and guide customers toward a production-ready, enterprise-approved Managed OpenShift architecture.
You will need to be able to confidently articulate our value proposition to leadership, operations teams, and developers within the account. Using architecture walkthroughs, business-value conversations, and Success Planning, you will help provide an end-to-end path to production that allows customers to realize the business value of Cloud Services and understand the path forward with Red Hat as a trusted partner.
You will work closely with account teams, Customer Success, and Red Hat 's Managed OpenShift Product and SRE teams to identify opportunities and gaps, provide ongoing product feedback, and ensure a positive customer experience that results in revenue generation and ongoing renewal.

Partner with account teams and Customer Success to identify customer use cases, challenges, and blockers to adoption and consumption of Managed OpenShift within new and existing customer accounts

Plan, design, and execute tailored solutions that address customer adoption blockers, leveraging additional support and resources from Red Hat as required

Demonstrate consultative selling skills, designing and proposing solutions with business acumen

Share knowledge and findings with team members to allow them to learn from your successes and mistakes
Facilitate pre- and post-sales activities including technical deep dives, proofs of concept, workshops, and internal enablement events

5+ years of experience as a sales engineer, consultant, IT architect, or in an equivalent customer-facing technical role within enterprise accounts
Strong knowledge of cloud services providers (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform) and their native services ecosystems
Hands-on experience with Red Hat 's managed cloud services offerings, including ROSA and ARO, and solid working knowledge of Red Hat OpenShift
Solid product knowledge across the broader Red Hat portfolio, including Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, and Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization

We are looking for a Systems Architect to own our technical strategy across a complex, multi-product portfolio serving the public housing authority sector. This is a senior, cross-functional leadership role. The right person will help define where our technical landscape is going, make the decisions that give engineering teams clarity and direction, and build relationships across the organization that turn the architecture into a coherent platform.
You will be joining at a significant moment. We are actively rationalizing a product portfolio that has grown in complexity over many years, modernizing our infrastructure, addressing security gaps, and laying the technical foundation for new capabilities including AI-driven features. This role is the architectural cornerstone of that effort.
What you will own
Technical strategy
Define and maintain the overall technical architecture across all products.
Create and communicate a coherent roadmap for platform evolution, modernization, and debt reduction.
Set standards for security, code quality, deployment, and observability across all engineering teams.
Own the decision framework for technology selection evaluate new tools, platforms, and approaches against long-term goals rather than familiarity or short-term convenience.
Drive the transition from bespoke, per-customer customizations toward a scalable, configuration-driven product model.
Platform and infrastructure
Lead architectural decisions for our Azure hosted software, including resource standardization, cost optimization, and environment consistency across cloud and on-premises deployments.
Define and improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release processes to reduce manual error and increase deployment confidence.
Design and oversee the evolution of our API layer, including identity management consolidation, authorization granularity, containerization, and tenant isolation.
Oversee the reporting architecture strategy, including the transition away from Crystal Reports and the definition of a modern, maintainable reporting platform.
Cross-functional leadership
Partner with Product Management to ensure technical strategy and product roadmap are genuinely aligned.
Communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders including Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services and senior leadership about technical decisions and their business implications.
Mentor and provide technical direction to engineering teams.
Champion a culture of engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, and documentation across the organization.
What we need from you
C# and .NET: Hands-on expertise with C#. Must understand the migration landscape and can make principled decisions about when and how to modernize.
JavaScript / TypeScript and at least one major frontend framework: Strong working knowledge of React or Angular.
SQL Server: Expert-level understanding of SQL Server, including query optimization, schema design, and reporting infrastructure. Experience with SSRS & SSIS is required.
Azure: Experienced and comfortable with cloud based infrastructure and services.
Security architecture: Experience designing and enforcing security standards including secrets management, tenant isolation, authentication and authorization patterns, and API security.
3+ years of experience: With a meaningful portion in senior or principal engineering or architecture roles, ideally in product companies with complex, multi-version environments.

Desktop software: Experience designing, shipping, and maintaining Windows based desktop applications. Understanding the specific pain of installers, upgrade paths, configuration management, multi-version support, and the operational reality of on-premises Windows environments.
Delphi: Experience with legacy Delphi codebases is a genuine differentiator. The ideal candidate will understand the specific constraints and modernization options this creates.
AWS: Secondary cloud experience, particularly S3 and multi-cloud considerations.
Containerization: Practical experience with Docker and container orchestration.
Housing or government software domain: Familiarity with compliance-driven, government-adjacent software environments is an advantage but not a requirement.

The Aspen Group (TAG) is one of the largest and most trusted retail healthcare business support organizations in the U.S., supporting over 23,000 healthcare professionals and team members at more than 1,150 locations across 48 states.

Our five supported healthcare practices operate under the brands Aspen Dental, ClearChoice, WellNow, Chapter Aesthetic Studio, and Lovet. We’re committed to enabling healthcare professionals to focus on patient care while we handle the business operations that support them.
We are seeking an Infrastructure Systems Architect to own architectural oversight of the systems that manage, monitor, and secure a device ecosystem of approximately 50,000 endpoints supporting 20,000+ users across 1,500+ locations for a large dental services organization (DSO) and affiliated medical services businesses.

This is a senior individual contributor role that is equal parts architecture and hands-on engineering: the successful candidate will help define the target-state design for fleet management, telemetry, and automation platforms, and then help build the integrations, services, and tooling that make that design real.
The majority of the scope centers on enterprise endpoint management and monitoring at scale. The role also extends to the platforms and workstations that run clinical applications and connected clinical devices, including digital X-ray, CBCT imaging, and intraoral 3D scanning systems.

The ideal candidate has built and supported scalable, enterprise-grade device fleet management and observability systems, writes production-quality code, and has led large-scale device deployment and integration programs.
This role provides architectural oversight and advanced technical support to the Endpoint Engineering, Field Support, Implementation, Network and Imaging Modality teams, and serves as the final technical authority for fleet management systems design.

Architecture & Strategy
Champion the effort to define the target-state architecture, standards, design patterns, and roadmap for endpoint management, telemetry, inventory, patching, and remote support platforms.
Establish architectural governance: design review processes, architecture decision records, non-functional requirements, and exception handling.
Evaluate current state commercial endpoint management, RMM, and observability platforms to identify gaps and opportunities to upgrade or augment functionality with custom tooling. Lead proof-of-concept work and build-vs-buy analyses with TCO and operational-burden reasoning.
Design for scale and resilience: multi-tenant/multi-brand separation, safe and effective rollouts.
Partner with Security and Infrastructure leadership to align fleet architecture with Zero Trust principles, conditional access, device compliance posture, and least-privilege models.
Produce and maintain authoritative documentation: architecture diagrams, data flows, integration contracts, runbooks, and roadmaps.
Hands-On Engineering & Development
Design and build the tooling, APIs, connectors, and automation frameworks that integrate endpoint management platforms with ITSM, CMDB, identity, asset, and location data systems of record.
Write production-quality code in .NET, Go, Python, and JavaScript/TypeScript for agents, microservices, orchestration jobs, and internal tooling.
Collaborate with observability team to help build device telemetry and observability that provide accurate real-time fleet health, compliance, and inventory reporting.
Develop self-healing and remediation automations that detect and corrects failed policy or application deployments and configuration non-compliance without human intervention.
Implement CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, testing, and release management practices for all fleet management tooling and configuration artifacts.
Prototype and harden new capabilities before transitioning them to the Endpoint Engineering and Operations teams for day-to-day ownership.
Deployment & Integration Programs
Lead the implementation of best practices for fleetwide safe and effective application deployments.
Provide architectural oversight for large-scale device deployment, refresh, migration, and DeNovo/acquisition integration programs.
Help design zero-touch provisioning, imaging, and enrollment workflows that allow field and third-party technicians to deploy devices consistently with minimal specialized skill.
Define the technical integration playbook for acquired practices and new-build locations, including device onboarding, standards conformance, and remediation of non-standard estates.
Clinical Systems Scope
Extend fleet management, monitoring, and patching standards to workstations and appliances that host clinical applications and connected clinical devices, including digital X-ray, CBCT, and intraoral 3D scanning systems.
Design management approaches for constrained or vendor-controlled clinical endpoints, balancing security and patch currency against vendor support requirements and clinical uptime.
Ensure fleet management designs support HIPAA safeguards and appropriate handling of systems that touch protected health information.
Leadership & Advanced Support
Serve as the final escalation point for complex, cross-domain technical issues involving application deployments, device management, telemetry, and integration systems.
Mentor Principal, Senior, and mid-level engineers in system design, software engineering practice, automation, and documentation rigor.
Participate in cross-functional design and readiness reviews ensuring solutions meet enterprise SLAs, security requirements, and supportability standards.
Translate technical direction into clear recommendations and trade-offs for leadership teams.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
Experience: 10+ years in systems architecture, platform engineering, or software engineering roles, including significant experience designing and operating device fleet management and monitoring systems at enterprise scale (10,000+ devices; 50,000+ preferred) across a highly distributed, multi-site footprint.
Technical Skills
Experience with endpoint agent architecture and lifecycle: deployment, versioning, health monitoring, and safe rollback across a large fleet.
Strong, current application development experience with production code in one or more major programming languages or frameworks (.NET/C#, Go, Python, and JavaScript/TypeScript).
Proven design and delivery of distributed, service-oriented systems: REST/gRPC APIs, message queues and event-driven patterns, relational and time-series data stores, caching, and secure secrets management.
Familiarity with commercial endpoint management platforms — Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, MECM/SCCM, and JAMF.
Monitoring and observability tooling and practice (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus or equivalent), including metrics, logging, alerting design, and alert-fatigue management.
Cloud platform experience (Azure & GCP preferred; AWS acceptable), containerization, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or equivalent).

Wir entwickeln Systeme, an denen das operative Geschäft unserer Kunden hängt: Anwendungen für Schadenregulierung, Provisionierung, Vertriebssteuerung, ERP- und Logistikprozesse sowie digitale Kunden- und Partnerportale. Wenn solche Systeme nicht funktionieren, entsteht nicht nur ein schlechtes Nutzererlebnis. Es entstehen Fehler, Verzögerungen, Kosten und im Zweifel echte Geschäftsrisiken.
Solche Systeme entstehen nicht durch zusätzliche Kapazität und sauber verwaltete Übergaben. Sie entstehen durch Teams, die das Problem als Ganzes verstehen und Verantwortung dafür übernehmen. Genau dafür gibt es Envidual als spezialisierte IT-Beratung.
Wir übernehmen Verantwortung von der fachlichen Analyse über UX und Architektur bis zur technischen Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung. Dabei verstehen wir Softwareentwicklung nicht als Abarbeitung vorsortierter Tickets. Wir durchdringen die Prozesse, hinterfragen Anforderungen und treffen Entscheidungen, die auch langfristig tragen.
Unsere Teams sind bewusst schlank und interdisziplinär aufgestellt. Wer an einem Projekt arbeitet, kennt nicht nur seinen eigenen Ausschnitt, sondern versteht das Projekt, das System, das Produkt als Ganzes.
Diesen Anspruch stellen wir auch an die Menschen, die zu uns kommen: fachliche Neugier, technisches Urteilsvermögen und die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung nicht an der eigenen Rollengrenze abzugeben.
Aufgaben
Du entwirfst und verantwortest die Lösungs- und Systemarchitektur geschäftskritischer Anwendungen in komplexen, häufig gewachsenen Systemlandschaften.
Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen und nichtfunktionale Qualitätsziele in tragfähige technische Entscheidungen. Dazu gehören unter anderem Sicherheit, Wartbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit, Verfügbarkeit, Performance und Integrationsfähigkeit.
Du analysierst bestehende Systeme, identifizierst technische Risiken und Schulden und entwickelst realistische Zielarchitekturen und Modernisierungspfade.
Du entscheidest nicht nach Technologie-Trends, sondern nach Kontext. Du bewertest Architekturansätze, Cloud-Komponenten, Integrationsmuster und Plattformen anhand ihrer tatsächlichen Vor- und Nachteile.
Du bleibst nah an der Umsetzung. Durch Prototypen, Architektur-Spikes, Reviews und gemeinsame Arbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams stellst du sicher, dass Architektur nicht nur auf Diagrammen funktioniert.
Du dokumentierst Entscheidungen verständlich, machst Zielkonflikte transparent und schaffst Orientierung für Entwickler, Fachbereiche und technische Stakeholder.
Du entwickelst unsere Architektur- und Engineering-Standards weiter und bringst neue Ansätze wie Agentic Engineering kontrolliert in produktive Projektumgebungen.
Qualifikation
Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung und bereits Architekturverantwortung für produktive, komplexe Systeme übernommen.
Du bist technisch weiterhin hands-on und verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Springboot und Angular, sowie modernen Webarchitekturen.
Du kennst unterschiedliche Architekturansätze und Integrationsmuster – von modularen Monolithen und Microservices über ereignisgetriebene Systeme bis zu API- und Plattformarchitekturen.
Du kannst fachliche Anforderungen und Qualitätsziele wie Sicherheit, Verfügbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Wartbarkeit strukturiert erfassen und priorisieren.
Du hast belastbare Erfahrung mit Cloud-Architekturen, Containern, CI/CD und dem Betrieb verteilter Systeme. Idealerweise kennst du Azure/GCP/AWS/OpenShift aus produktiven Projekten.
Du kannst bestehende Systeme und Codebasen bewerten, technische Risiken transparent machen und daraus realistische Zielbilder und Modernisierungsstrategien ableiten.
Du hast eine breite Kenntnis betriebsprägender Architekturprinzipien wie u.a. Zero-Trust, Observability, Resilience und Fault Tolerance sowie deren Einfluss auf Sicherheit, Wartbarkeit und Betriebsstabilität.
Du dokumentierst Architekturentscheidungen präzise und verständlich, beispielsweise mit Architecture Decision Records, C4-Modellen oder vergleichbaren Formaten.
Du kannst Entwickler fachlich führen, Stakeholder beraten und unterschiedliche Interessen zu einer tragfähigen Entscheidung zusammenbringen.
Du arbeitest dich tief in neue Fachdomänen ein und gibst dich nicht mit technisch eleganten Lösungen zufrieden, die das eigentliche Geschäftsproblem verfehlen.

Projekte, die zählen : Du arbeitest an Anwendungen, die zentrale Geschäftsprozesse unserer Kunden tragen. Deine Entscheidungen wirken sich nicht auf ein internes Demo-Projekt aus, sondern auf Systeme, die täglich produktiv genutzt werden.
Verantwortung mit echtem Einfluss : Bei uns bekommst du nicht nur Aufgaben, sondern Gestaltungsspielraum. Du kannst technische Entscheidungen, Prozesse und Arbeitsweisen aktiv beeinflussen. Titel entscheiden dabei nicht darüber, wessen Argument zählt.
Lernen mit Substanz: Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Entwicklern, Architekten, Business Analysts und Designern zusammen. Statt eines starren Mentor-Mentee-Programms bekommst du direktes Feedback und Coaching, das zu deiner Rolle und deinen Zielen passt.
Flexibilität, die im Team funktioniert: Wir arbeiten nicht nach starren Anwesenheitszeiten. Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitstag flexibel und stimmst dich so mit deinem Team und dem Projekt ab, dass Zusammenarbeit und Verlässlichkeit nicht darunter leiden.
Ein Arbeitsumfeld, das professionelles Arbeiten unterstützt: Dich erwarten hochwertige Hardware, moderne Arbeitsplätze und ein gut ausgestattetes Büro in München – inklusive zweier Terrassen und einer Küche mit Getränken und Snacks.
Eine Vergütung, die deiner Verantwortung entspricht: Wir vergüten Erfahrung, fachliche Tiefe und übernommene Verantwortung angemessen. Der Satz ist glaubwürdiger als „überdurchschnittliche Bezahlung ist Standard“. Noch stärker wäre er mit transparenten Gehaltsbändern.
Ein Team ohne Statusspiele: Wir kommunizieren direkt, helfen einander und sprechen Probleme offen an. Regelmäßige Team-Events gehören dazu, sind aber nicht der Ersatz für eine gute Zusammenarbeit im Alltag.
Ergänzend bieten wir Corporate Benefits, vergünstigte Fitnessangebote und weitere Mitarbeitervorteile.

# Lead / Principal AI Infrastructure Architect
## Über die Position
Wir suchen einen **Lead / Principal AI Infrastructure Architect**, der die durchgängige Verantwortung für den Entwurf, die Bereitstellung und die Optimierung der Infrastruktur für groß angelegte Workloads im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) und maschinelles Lernen (ML) übernimmt.
Der Schwerpunkt der Rolle liegt auf der Architektur hochskalierbarer und kosteneffizienter Rechenumgebungen, einschließlich **GPU-Clustern, Plattformen für verteiltes Training, Infrastruktur für Model-Serving, Netzwerktechnik, Speicherlösungen, Orchestrierung sowie cloudbasierten KI/ML-Plattformen**.
Sie übersetzen Geschäftsziele, Service-Level-Anforderungen, Sicherheitsstandards und technische Rahmenbedingungen in robuste Infrastrukturarchitekturen. Sie evaluieren alternative Lösungen, treffen fundierte Architekturentscheidungen und stellen sicher, dass die Plattformen auf **Leistung, Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit, Sicherheit und Kosteneffizienz** ausgelegt sind.
Als technische Führungskraft übernehmen Sie die architektonische Leitung, etablieren Engineering-Standards und Best Practices, betreuen (mentoren) Ingenieure und Architekten und arbeiten eng mit Kunden und Stakeholdern zusammen, um Infrastrukturstrategien und Roadmaps zu definieren.
## Kernaufgaben
### KI/ML-Infrastrukturarchitektur
* Übernahme der Gesamtverantwortung für Architektur und Design der Infrastruktur für groß angelegte KI/ML-Systeme – vom ersten Konzept bis zur Implementierung und Bereitstellung.
* Entwurf der Infrastruktur für verteiltes KI/ML-Training, Inferenz und Model-Serving-Workloads.
* Architektur und Optimierung des gesamten Rechen-Stacks, einschließlich **Rechenleistung, GPUs/Beschleunigern, Netzwerktechnik, Speicher, Orchestrierung und Model-Serving**.
* Evaluierung von Architekturalternativen und Treffen fundierter Entscheidungen auf der Basis von Leistung, Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit, Kosten, Sicherheit und Kundenanforderungen.
* Sicherstellung, dass die Infrastrukturarchitekturen mit vereinbarten geschäftlichen SLAs, technischen Standards und betrieblichen Anforderungen im Einklang stehen.
### GPU- und Distributed Computing
* Entwurf und Optimierung groß angelegter **GPU- und beschleunigerbasierter Cluster** für KI/ML-Workloads.
* Evaluierung und Auswahl geeigneter GPU-/Beschleunigertechnologien basierend auf den Anforderungen der Workloads.
* Entwurf von Hochleistungsnetzwerken und Interconnect-Architekturen für verteiltes Training.
* Architektur von Speicherlösungen, die KI/ML-Workloads mit hohem Durchsatz unterstützen.
* Identifizierung und Behebung von Infrastruktur-Engpässen, die sich auf Training, Inferenz, Durchsatz oder Skalierbarkeit auswirken. * Optimierung der Infrastruktur hinsichtlich Leistung, Energieverbrauch, Auslastung und Kosten.
### Cloud-KI/ML-Architektur
* Fungieren als technischer Experte für mindestens eine der großen Hyperscaler-Plattformen, wie z. B. **AWS, Microsoft Azure oder Google Cloud**.
* Anwendung fundierter Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Cloud-KI/ML-Dienste, Rechenplattformen, Beschleuniger (Accelerators), Netzwerk, Speicher, Orchestrierung und Preismodelle.
* Bewertung von Cloud-Architekturoptionen und Empfehlung von Lösungen, die den Anforderungen an Workload, Sicherheit, Leistung und Kosten entsprechen.
* Entwurf skalierbarer Cloud- und Hybrid-Infrastrukturen für KI/ML-Workloads auf Unternehmens- und Großskalenebene.
* Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten zur Optimierung der Cloud-Auslastung und der Infrastrukturkosten.
### Architekturbewertung und Governance
* Leitung von Bewertungen und Überprüfungen bestehender und geplanter KI/ML-Infrastrukturumgebungen.
* Identifizierung von Architekturlücken, technischen Risiken, Leistungsengpässen, Skalierbarkeitsproblemen und Optimierungspotenzialen.
* Festlegung von Strategien zur Problembehebung und Erarbeitung technischer Empfehlungen.
* Etablierung von Architekturstandards, Mustern (Patterns) und Best Practices für die KI-Infrastruktur.
* Dokumentation von Architekturentscheidungen, Annahmen, Abwägungen (Trade-offs) und technischen Begründungen.
* Sicherstellung der Einhaltung relevanter Sicherheits-, Regulierungs-, Governance- und Kundenstandards.
### Infrastruktur-Roadmap und Kapazitätsplanung
* Definition und Pflege der Technologie-Roadmap für die KI/ML-Infrastruktur.
* Entwicklung von Kapazitätsplänen unter Berücksichtigung der Anforderungen von Geschäftsbereichen, Produkten und KI/ML-Workloads.
* Prognose des Bedarfs an Rechenleistung, Speicher, Netzwerkkapazität und Beschleunigern.
* Entwicklung von Kostenmodellen für die Infrastruktur und Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten zur Kostenoptimierung.
* Planung der technologischen Weiterentwicklung, des Workload-Wachstums und der Plattform-Skalierbarkeit.
### Automatisierung, Bereitstellung und Betrieb
* Entwurf von Bereitstellungs- und Automatisierungsstrategien für eine zuverlässige, reproduzierbare und skalierbare KI/ML-Infrastruktur.
* Etablierung geeigneter **CI/CD- und Infrastructure-as-Code-Ansätze** für KI/ML-Plattformen und -Workloads.
* Unterstützung der automatisierten Bereitstellung von KI-Systemen, Modellen und Datenpipelines in Produktionsumgebungen.

* Etablierung von Strategien für Monitoring und Observability über Infrastruktur- und MLOps-Umgebungen hinweg.

Our SAP platform is at a pivotal moment; moving to RISE, migrating to s/4, embracing Clean Core, and building the BTP foundations that will power our next decade of innovation. The Platform Architect is the person who connects all these dots: architecture, extensibility, developer enablement, and governance.

If you want to shape a global SAP landscape across a portfolio of iconic luxury Maisons, this is the role. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?Within the SAP platform team, the SAP Platform Architect defines and governs the SAP platform architecture across S/4HANA (ERP, EWM, GTS-), SAP BTP, and all integration touchpoints.

Shaping the technology landscape, setting guardrails, and ensuring every extension or customisation is justified, sustainable, and future-proof.

You will lead the OSBF Design Authority, promote Clean Core principles and SAP-s extensibility strategy (side-by-side vs. in-app), and ensure alignment with both SAP-s product roadmap and our enterprise architecture. Your impact spans across a multi-stream technical roadmap covering 4 strategic pillars: 1.

Architecture Vision & Roadmap Own and drive the architectural direction of the platform across Core Architecture, BTP & Development.

Participate in strategic architectural decisions such as use cases for BTP, Federated platforms (Mendix, Tulip, Pega-), ERP/EWM decoupling, S/4HANA continuous evolution, including associated topics such as Job Scheduling or establishing a Printing Platform for the group.

Collaborate with the Enterprise Architecture team on cross-cutting concerns such as Disaster Recovery design and enterprise-wide technology alignment. Evolve the Platform to further integrate CI/CD practices. Integrate Richemont AI strategy in the platform roadmap & design.

Define consumable and reusable services for product teams that accelerate delivery, increase product teams- autonomy, and reduce the need for custom development, duplicated effort, and reliance on central platform expertise. 2.

Clean Core Governance & Extensibility Strategy Define and enforce Clean Core guidelines: minimise custom code, maximise standard, and leverage key-user extensibility and BTP side-by-side extensions.

Own the decision framework for -where to extend-: in-app (BAdIs, RAP, key-user extensibility) vs. side-by-side (CAP on BTP, Integration Suite, or Federated Platforms). Guide product teams on the right extensibility pattern for each use case. Conduct architecture reviews for all significant developments. 3.

Standards, Patterns & Guardrails Integrates Group Standards for reusable architecture patterns, in particular for API design and ownership, event-driven integration, data models, CDS views, and Fiori apps.

Champion configuration as Code for sap platforms, including BTP (Terraform) which adheres to Richemont guidelines in terms of security, Identity management and connectivity. Publish and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and reference architectures.

Guide the technical archiving and data volume management strategy and application retirement (ILM). Provide architectural direction on data lifecycle decisions that impact platform performance, storage costs, and compliance. 4. Community & Enablement Participate in cross-team design reviews and lead the SAP platform Architecture Board.

Establish and animate an Architect Community across the product teams. Stay ahead of SAP technology evolution through continuous learning, SAP community engagement, and vendor dialogue. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

Education & Experience 10+ years of progressive experience in SAP ecosystems, with deep expertise across S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and hybrid integration landscapes. 3+ years in an SAP platform architecture role. Master-s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Technical Expertise SAP S/4HANA: Deep understanding of S/4HANA architecture, Clean Core methodology, custom code analysis (ATC, Custom Code Migration app), and extensibility options (BAdIs, RAP, key-user extensibility).

SAP BTP: Strong knowledge of the BTP service portfolio - CAP, Integration Suite, SAP Build Work Zone, HANA Cloud, AI Core / Generative AI Hub, Event Mesh, Destination & Connectivity services. Architecture Patterns: Proven expertise in API-first design, event-driven architecture, side-by-side extensions, and Fiori/UX architecture.

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, configuration as code - Terraform Security Awareness: Solid understanding of SAML 2.0, OIDC, SSO, and identity management concepts RISE: Understanding of the RISE with SAP operating model and SAP Cloud ALM.

Soft Skills & Behaviours Visionary yet pragmatic: Balances long-term architecture ambition with short-term delivery reality (strategic vs. tactical). Strong conviction with open mind: Defends architectural principles but listens to field constraints.

Excellent communicator: Explains complex architecture concepts to business stakeholders, product teams, and technical audiences alike. Collaborative authority: Influences without commanding; earns trust through expertise. Works with security, operations, and enterprise architecture - not in place of them.

Systems thinking: Sees the whole SAP landscape as interconnected and integrated within a global, heterogeneous enterprise landscape. Never forgets the Enterprise Architecture guiding principles. Intellectual curiosity: Continuously tracks SAP innovation and industry best practices.

Braze is making AI the default way of working across the company. Our Applied AI Architects are forward-deployed practitioners who combine domain judgment with hands-on build capability: they embed with business teams, treat employees as users and workflows as product surfaces, and ship working agents on shared infrastructure.

The function runs in two tracks.

GTM Architects are permanently embedded in the GTM organization, each owning a portion of a customer and prospect lifecycle that spans Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support; when they address friction in one stage, they work the surrounding levers holistically, mapping how those functions connect today and how AI could connect them better.

G&A Architects rotate across corporate functions like Finance, People, Legal, and Operations, driving each cohort to self-sufficiency.
You will lead this team. That means defining how a new role category operates, owning the portfolio of engagements across the business, and answering for the outcomes: adoption that persists, workflows that measurably improve, and committed bets that read out in business metrics like sales ramp time, quota capacity, and competitive win rate.
This is a player-coach role. You will carry enough build and field surface yourself to keep your judgment current, while your primary output is the team: who they are, where they embed, what they ship, and whether it works.

You inherit the hiring manager seat for all Architect roles, a unified interview loop, and an operating model with real momentum. What the function becomes from there is yours to shape, in close partnership with our Director of Applied AI Product, the CIO and CTO organizations, and the leaders of the functions your team serves.

Build the team. Close the open Architect reqs across both tracks (GTM and G&A), then own onboarding, development, and performance for a team of senior, highly autonomous ICs operating in a role category that barely exists in the market. Define what good looks like and what the career path is.
Own the engagement portfolio. Decide where Architects embed, what they prioritize, and when they rotate or scale back. Balance permanent GTM surface ownership against rotational G&A engagements. Say no to good ideas so the team ships great ones.
Answer for the bets. Own delivery and measurement of the committed GTM bets (sales ramp time, quota capacity / customer-facing time, competitive win rate) and run the promotion pipeline for G&A candidate bets. Every bet pairs a business outcome with leading indicators; you keep both honest.
Run the operating discipline. Enforce the engagement lifecycle (discovery, prioritization, readout, design, build, deliver, monitor) and the cohort maturity model. Adoption is the bar: an ignored output is a bug, and your team operates what it ships until it is productized.
Stay hands-on. Review agent designs, specs, and output quality at the system level. Carry a build surface of your own. Your field and build credibility is what earns the team its seat in pipeline reviews and functional staff meetings.
Compound through the platform. Partner with the Director of Applied AI Product to move field-proven patterns into shared infrastructure, and to feed field reality back into platform requirements, evaluation criteria, and measurement frameworks.
Be the executive interface. Negotiate embed agreements with CRO and CBO leadership and functional executives, represent the function's results and roadmap to senior leadership, and protect your team's focus when demand outstrips capacity, which it will.
Write the playbook. The role category is being defined in real time across the industry. Document what works, publish it internally, and make Braze a reference point for how a scaled SaaS company runs applied AI.

A proven leader of senior technical ICs. You have built and led high-autonomy teams: forward-deployed engineering, solutions consulting or architecture, field engineering, or an applied AI/ML group. You know how to manage outcomes without hovering, and how to coach people more specialized than you.
A builder with current hands. You have personally built AI agents, automations, or LLM-powered tools that changed how real work gets done, and you can evaluate someone else's system design, retrieval logic, and output quality without an interpreter.
Credible in the field. You have spent real time in or alongside the commercial motion of a B2B SaaS company. You can sit in a pipeline review, an EBR, or a functional leadership meeting and have the room take you seriously.
A portfolio operator. You think in terms of impact, feasibility, and sequencing across many competing demands, and you can defend your prioritization to executives who wanted a different answer.
Fluent in measurement. You can design a baseline, argue a leading indicator, dollarize an efficiency gain, and tell the difference between a metric that proves a mechanism and one that flatters a narrative.
A zero-to-one leader. You have stood up a function, practice, or team where no playbook existed, and you are comfortable being accountable for results while the ground is still moving.

As part of Capgemini Financial Services team, you will advise clients on their cloud transformation and observability journey while contributing to the design and implementation of modern monitoring and telemetry platforms.As an Observability Cloud Architect, you will play a key role in defining observability strategies, designing target architectures, and enabling organizations to gain end-to-end visibility across cloud and hybrid environments.

s.h: ## WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE ##

s.t:
Eraneos ist eine internationale Beratungsgruppe für Strategie, Transformation und Technologie, die Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, in einer dynamischen digitalen Welt erfolgreich zu sein.

Mit erstklassigen Expertinnen und Experten aus Business und Technologie befähigen wir unsere Kunden, neue Massstäbe für nachhaltige Transformationen zu setzen - von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung.

Ob bei der Gestaltung zukunftsfähiger Organisationen, der Erschliessung neuer Potenziale durch Daten und KI oder der Absicherung von Unternehmen durch ganzheitliche Cybersicherheit: Wir liefern Resultate pragmatisch und zielgerichtet.

Unser Team von rund 1-200 engagierten Mitarbeitenden ist in Büros in der Schweiz, Deutschland, den Niederlanden, Spanien, Dänemark, Schweden, Österreich, Grossbritannien, Singapur und den USA vertreten und verbindet globale Perspektiven mit starken lokalen Wurzeln.

An den Schweizer Standorten Zürich, Bern und Lausanne arbeiten rund 450 Mitarbeitende.
# **Das ist der Job - Deine Hauptaufgaben** #
* Du entwickelst tragfähige Data- & AI-Lösungsarchitekturen. Gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen, IT und Delivery Lead konkretisierst du Anforderungen und übersetzt sie in umsetzbare Konzepte. Du wägst Standardprodukte, Managed Services und Eigenentwicklungen gegeneinander ab.
* Du gestaltest das Zusammenspiel der gesamten Lösung. Du verbindest Daten, AI-Modelle, Anwendungen, Schnittstellen und Infrastruktur und entwickelst Sicherheits-, Berechtigungs-, Deployment\- und Betriebskonzepte für Cloud-, On-Prem- und hybride Umgebungen.
* Du arbeitest selbst an der technischen Umsetzung. Du überprüfst kritische Annahmen durch technische Spikes und Prototypen, implementierst anspruchsvolle Komponenten und begleitest die Lösung bis zum produktiven Einsatz.
* Du machst AI-Lösungen produktionsreif. Du definierst mit dem Team Anforderungen an Tests, Evaluation, Monitoring und Betrieb und wägst Qualität, Performance, Verfügbarkeit und Gesamtkosten gegeneinander ab.
* Du übernimmst technische Führung. Du setzt Engineering-Standards, führst Code- und Architekturreviews durch und coachst Engineers. Dabei entwickelst du auch den qualitätsgesicherten Einsatz von AI im Software Development Lifecycle weiter.
* Du berätst Kunden und vertrittst technische Entscheidungen. Du moderierst Lösungs- und Architekturworkshops, erklärst Alternativen und deren Konsequenzen und stimmst Architektur, Security und Betrieb mit den zuständigen Fachpersonen ab.
# **Dieser Job ist für dich, wenn** #
* Praktische Erfahrung mit produktiven AI-Lösungen im Enterprise-Umfeld. Du hast Lösungen selbst entworfen und implementiert und kennst Entwicklung, Deployment und Betrieb aus eigener Erfahrung.
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in Agentic AI und modernen AI-Architekturen. Du verstehst Agents, Agent-Teams und deren Orchestrierung, Tool-Calling, strukturierte Ausgaben sowie multimodale Verarbeitung mit Voice und Vision.
* Technische Tiefe in Software und Daten. Du beherrschst Service- und API-Design und verstehst Datenmodelle, Datenflüsse, Fachsystemintegration, asynchrone Verarbeitung und verteilte Systeme.
* Erfahrung mit Cloud, On-Prem, Managed Services, Modellbereitstellung, Netzwerk und Infrastrukturautomatisierung.
* Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Sicherheit und Produktionsreife. Du berücksichtigst Identitäten, Rollen, Datenzugriffe, Secrets und Auditierbarkeit ebenso wie AI-spezifische Risiken. Tests, CI/CD, Observability, Versionierung und Wiederanlauf gehören für dich zur Lösungsarchitektur.
* Beratungskompetenz und Freude am People Business, sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau.
# **Als i-Tüpfelchen bringst du mit ** #
* Erfahrung mit anspruchsvollen Betriebsumgebungen: Du hast lokale Modellbereitstellung, GPU-Infrastruktur oder Lösungen mit besonderen Anforderungen an Datenschutz, Verfügbarkeit oder Isolation realisiert.
* Erfahrung mit strukturierter Architekturdokumentation: Du nutzt beispielsweise arc42 und dokumentierst Architekturentscheidungen so, dass Kunden und Umsetzungsteams damit weiterarbeiten können.
* Erfahrung mit AI-gestütztem Engineering: Du hast Coding-Assistenten und Agents über die persönliche Nutzung hinaus in Entwicklungs-, Review- und Testprozesse integriert und deren Qualität abgesichert.
* Erfahrung mit Wiederverwendung und Presales: Du hast Referenzarchitekturen oder gemeinsame Komponenten aufgebaut oder durch technische Beratung und überzeugende Lösungsentwürfe zur Gewinnung neuer Mandate beigetragen.
Auch wenn nicht alle Anforderungen vollständig erfüllt sind, freuen wir uns sehr über eine Bewerbung.
# **Dein nächster Schritt zur erfolgreichen Bewerbung** #
* Hüseyin als deine Ansprechperson freut sich auf deine Direktbewerbung über unsere Webseite (Lebenslauf, Diplome und Arbeitszeugnisse in PDF).
Diversity wird bei uns grossgeschrieben - zeig uns, was dich ausmacht, und schick uns deine Unterlagen noch heute!
*Bewerbungen per E-Mail sowie von Personaldienstleistern werden nicht berücksichtigt und direkt gelöscht.*

We help the world run betterAt SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we-ll bring out the best in you. We-re builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what-s next. The work is challenging - but it matters.

You-ll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What-s in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What you-ll doAs an Enterprise Architect (f/m/d), you will develop and maintain a comprehensive end-to-end enterprise architecture vision for assigned customers, aligned with their business strategy and transformation goals.

You will act as a trusted transformation partner for executive stakeholders and collaborate closely with account teams to drive value-driven architecture execution.

You will lead and support activities such as: Guide customers through their enterprise and cloud transformation journey, from architecture vision to execution and realization, leveraging enterprise archetypes and scalable delivery models.

Provide enterprise architecture guidance based on SAP-s Reference Architecture Framework and Clean Core principles, ensuring customers fully benefit from SAP cloud qualities. Act as a strategic advisor for CIOs and other CxO stakeholders, driving architecture effectiveness and decision-making.

Support solution adoption by identifying, mitigating, and governing architectural and technical risks across hybrid and cloud landscapes. Drive value realization through solution adoption, capability consumption, and measurable KPIs aligned to customer business outcomes.

Consolidate customer expectations and business goals into a tangible enterprise-level success plan, tracking value drivers and KPIs using SAP-s value framework. Serve as a trusted advisor ensuring secure, reliable, and extensible architectures for mission-critical business processes.

Establish effective architecture governance, engaging stakeholders across customer, partner, and SAP teams to ensure alignment on business goals, value drivers, and architectural standards. Align customers and partners with SAP-s Clean Core strategy, accelerate BTP adoption, and promote SAP architectural best practices across solution areas.

What You Bring Experience delivering enterprise-wide business transformation initiatives, aligning business strategy with target architecture and multi-year roadmaps. At Lightium, we are building next-generation photonic integrated circuits (PICs) based on thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN), and we are looking for an Enterprise Data & Systems Architect to become the technical backbone of our data platform and enterprise systems.

We seek a hands-on Enterprise Data & Systems Architect to own the technical architecture of our data infrastructure, automation and digital systems. The ownership spans from database architecture and data warehouse to PLM, ERP and MES systems, as well as test automation, serving both R&D and growing production flow.
